meta.name: Viaan Thakur
meta.title: Android Custom ROM Developer
meta.description: Android Custom ROM Developer, Kernel Maintainer, and Open Source Enthusiast focused on building fast, stable, and feature-rich Android experiences.

projects.name: AxionAOSP
projects.description: My own Android ROM project focused on performance, stability, and exceptional user experience. Built from AOSP with custom optimizations and thoughtful feature additions.

projects.name: Larry ROM Archive
projects.description: A large archive containing ROMs, kernels, recoveries, and Android resources for the community. Over 100 GB of curated files maintained for the Android modding ecosystem.

projects.name: Strato Kernel
projects.description: Custom kernel development focused on optimization, smoothness, and extended battery life. Fine-tuned schedulers, governors, and drivers for a snappier experience.

projects.name: Android Device Trees
projects.description: Maintaining and developing Android device trees, vendor trees, and related bring-up work. Supporting multiple devices across different OEMs.

projects.name: Nuvio Studio
projects.description: A web design and development studio where I serve as Lead Developer and Server Manager, building modern digital experiences and managing cloud infrastructure.

timeline.title: Started Android Modding
timeline.description: First steps into the Android modding world — flashing ROMs, exploring recoveries, and understanding the ecosystem.

timeline.title: First Custom ROM Build
timeline.description: Successfully compiled and flashed my first custom Android ROM from source. A defining moment in my development journey.

timeline.title: First Official Maintainer Role
timeline.description: Became an official device maintainer, taking responsibility for stable releases and community support.

timeline.title: Strato Kernel Born
timeline.description: Started custom kernel development with Strato Kernel, focusing on performance optimization and battery efficiency.

timeline.title: Created AxionAOSP
timeline.description: Founded AxionAOSP — my own Android ROM project with a vision for performance, stability, and great UX.

timeline.title: Joined Nuvio Studio
timeline.description: Joined Nuvio Studio as Lead Developer and Server Manager, expanding into web and cloud infrastructure work.

timeline.title: Larry ROM Archive Launched
timeline.description: Launched the Larry ROM Archive — a 100GB+ community resource hub for Android ROMs, kernels, and recoveries.

timeline.title: Expanding Open Source Impact
timeline.description: Continuing to grow open-source contributions, maintaining more devices, and building build infrastructure at scale.
